notes: Kuzo 0.2.9 (trial - not approved under PRO-AIC-0608 C1). New: "Connect multiple SLB files" - one rope recorded in several files, linked as sections in rope order, each gap entered as measured or estimated, a section can be flipped, overlap counted once, every section read against the rope's original calibration zero (an LMA step at a join is flagged and no result is proposed until you judge it), playback stops at each length not inspected, pass B reuses pass A's gaps. Older .slb: positions from 0 as WINTROS shows them, and a "Turn pass B round" switch set by you. Single-file .slb2 ropes are assessed as before.
